what: Frozen data of the B1 v2 Bayesian fit (2026-10-03 12:11 copy of the usage collector's runs.csv / runs3.csv, the scope-2 grade files and that day's limits state), sanitized for publication on 2026-10-08 (WP0a, docs/BAYES.md).

sanitization.ids: session ids and agent ids (runs*.csv: session, id, parent; baseline_runs.csv: session, root_agent_id, agent_id, parent_agent_id; state/*: session ids and agent ids anywhere) replaced by the first 16 hex of sha256(id); the row-kind sentinels 'main' and 'session' kept
sanitization.numbers: every other cell byte-identical (checked cell by cell); CSVs rewritten with LF line ends

evidence_id.checked_with: stack_limits.py at main d6046693 and at the v2 fit's worktree: the raw copy gives the v2 fit's evidence id (design.md line 5) under both; read_rows of the sanitized copy equals read_rows of the raw copy row for row after the id map
